tokens.name: blue-hour
tokens.usage: The primary brand color: the sky before sunrise. Hats, patch twill, coin enamel, the Z on light grounds. Text on bone: 12.9:1.

tokens.name: first-light
tokens.usage: The sun. Reserved for the sun in the Z mark, brass and gold plating, and one accent per piece. Never body text on bone (fails contrast); fine as text or thread on blue-hour (7.7:1).

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: The unexpected accent: the lime lichen on desert rock at dawn. Small doses only, such as a stitch line, a pin outline, or one stat. Never text on bone.

tokens.name: dawn-rose
tokens.usage: Secondary warm accent for the band just above the horizon. Bands and fills, not text.

tokens.name: rhyolite
tokens.usage: Warm stone gray. Alternate hat and tee color, rules on field stamps, secondary thread.

tokens.name: bone
tokens.usage: Off-white ground: tees, stamp paper, reversed Z on blue-hour.

tokens.name: char
tokens.usage: Near-black for dark tees and one-color screen prints.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page or garment ground behind content.

tokens.name: night-sky
tokens.usage: Large sky fields and slabs; lifts off the ground in the night theme.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the Z stroke on ground.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and taglines on ground.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Merch and title cards. All caps is fine here; this is the stencil voice.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Video title cards, thumbnails, post headers.

styles.name: patch
styles.usage: Rim text on coins, pins and patches. Tracked wide so embroidery and die-strikes stay legible.

styles.name: stamp
styles.usage: Field-stamp data only: coordinates, dates, sunrise times, Eos scores.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stamp label and value.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner padding of stamps and cards; clear space around the Z at small sizes.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked lockups and text blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Section spacing and large layout modules.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Field stamps, patches, title cards: square like issued gear.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small tags and buttons on the website.
